appDescription: A community app for reporting road conditions to nearby drivers.

function.name: GAZEE_CREATE_REPORT
function.description: Registers a road report with a specific location and condition explicitly stated by the driver.

reportTitle.description: A concise Korean road-condition title containing the driver's stated location and situation, without assistant or app invocation names or report-submission commands. The title retains stated uncertainty, negation, direction, and timing without adding causes or observations.

location.description: The specific road or place named in the reported observation, excluding the app invocation name. An empty string indicates no specific place was provided.

condition.description: The observed situation explicitly described by the driver, preserving negation and uncertainty. An empty string indicates no situation was provided.

utterance.description: The driver's latest report request in their original words, including its app invocation and wording even if the location or condition is missing.

function.name: GAZEE_READ_RECEIVED_REPORT
function.description: Provides the latest nearby driver report for a brief, conversational spoken update.
